query: SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',l.id,'target_kind',l.target_kind,'target_id',l.target_id,'allow_view',l.allow_view,'allow_download',l.allow_download,'allow_like',l.allow_like,'allow_flag',l.allow_flag,'expires_at',l.expires_at,'revoked_at',l.revoked_at,'passphrase',l.passphrase_hash IS NOT NULL,'opens',(SELECT count(*) FROM share_link_opens WHERE share_link_id=l.id),'unique_visitors',(SELECT count(DISTINCT visitor_hash) FROM share_link_opens WHERE share_link_id=l.id),'last_open',(SELECT max(opened_at) FROM share_link_opens WHERE share_link_id=l.id)) ORDER BY l.created_at DESC),'[]') AS "page!" FROM share_links l
